question: In what ways is the goddess identified with and as the activator of the womb-wheel?
premises: The goddess is described as consisting of the womb-wheel.
The goddess is directly identified as the womb-source.
The goddess is the one who activates the womb-wheel.
inference: The goddess embodies, is, and dynamically sets in motion the sacred womb-wheel.
plain_english: She consists of the womb-wheel, she is the womb, and she sets the womb-wheel in motion.
